title: Clear All: A Large-Scale Observational Study on Mobile Notification Drawers

scope_decision.qualification: Longitudinal Android notification-drawer state snapshots are analyzed for cross-snapshot item identity, age and grouped/count trajectories. They are a distinct observation family from arrival/removal callbacks. User interactions between samples are unobserved; neither a disappearing item nor a count drop is an observed dismissal or Clear All event.

source_method_variants: One requested 15-minute Android drawer-snapshot collector, with Doze-dependent realized intervals. The local Notification Listener history is an app capability and data source, but the reported study dataset is periodic pending-drawer states, not all callback rows.

Total raw pending-item count and visually grouped count are two parallel measures; the paper uses grouped count for subsequent analyses. They are not two alternative notification-arrival event constructors.
App category, rank, priority, age, clearability and mean-count user strata are separate fixed analyses. No source-declared selectable multiverse or constructor sensitivity is reported.

analysis_outputs_and_population_warnings: The 15-minute requested scheduler and 17.74-minute realized mean differ; neither is a notification-arrival cadence.

A unique item counted across snapshots is not an observed posted callback. The paper's printed four-part identity and released notebook's opaque key/postTime expression must not be silently equated. Unique-item counting uses raw Active arrays, independently of visual grouping; group-summary selection must not be moved upstream of unique-item counting or age.
A fall in drawer count can be caused by user dismissal, app/system removal, or unobserved intervening changes. The paper does not observe Clear All interactions between snapshots.

The 31-day age cap appears in version-linked analysis code, not in the paper's Figure 6 prose. The dataset archive is byte-pinned and ZIP-tested but its pickle payload has not been safely parsed or run, so numerical reproduction is unproved.
Old normalized app-session rubric ABSENT cells do not mean the source omitted app-session settings: app-session construction is not this paper's target.
